loss: mean cross-entropy without weight decay; accuracy also recorded

bn_convention.main: recalibrated: reset running stats, cumulative average (momentum None) over the fixed calibration subset in fixed order, batches of 500, training mode under no_grad and under the evaluated intervention state; then inference mode on the probes
bn_convention.reproduction: saved_stats: checkpoint running statistics, inference mode

directions.construction: Li et al. 2018 filter-wise normalisation; mask = conv weights (4-D) and fc.weight rows; biases and BN affine fixed; zero-norm blocks get zero; no orthogonalisation

analysis_A.robustness: 1-D slices along D of pairs 0-4 and E of pair 0, seeds 0/1/2, same range, 21 points
analysis_A.range_rule: keep [-0.25, 0.25] unless the local offset check at +-{0.05,0.1,0.25,0.5} along D (seed 0) gives a non-finite loss or a test-probe CE increase above 5 nats at +-0.25, or below 0.01 nats at +-0.25, for either method; any change applies to all methods and is documented

analysis_B.checkpoint: seed 0, epoch 6 = last update at r=16 (epochs 0-5); chosen from the schedule as the first saved checkpoint produced entirely under an active reduction
analysis_B.grid: same as A, pair 0 scaled at this checkpoint
analysis_B.secondary: 1-D along D: seed 0 epoch 12 (last update at r=24) under 16/24/32; control: plain seed 0 epoch 6 with the reduction hook under 16/24/32

analysis_C.points: initialisation (update 0) and epochs 6/12/18/30 (updates 0/2346/4692/7038/11730), identical steps for both runs
analysis_C.vector: all learned parameters incl. BN affine; running statistics excluded (the random-direction mask additionally excludes BN affine and biases)
analysis_C.basis: top-2 principal directions of the 10 pooled points centred at their mean; not filter-normalised
analysis_C.contour: target objective, recalibrated BN, 25x25 grid over the projected range with 20% margin

analysis_D.interpolated: all learned parameters incl. BN affine; running statistics recalibrated
analysis_D.barrier: max_alpha L - max(L(0), L(1)) on the 51-point grid
